description:
Own the server's lifetime so it runs only as long as needed, then returns control to the main task. Normal shutdown: once all N endpoints have received their tool call, signal completion, stop the server task, and hand the collected `CheckReport`s back. Missing reports: an agent may exit without ever calling `report-check-result` (crash/timeout) — treat as an unreported/failed check rather than hanging forever.

———
